create_connector_build_kv_transfer: create a vLLM KV transfer connector using KVConnectorFactory.create_connector with vllm config and role
register_connector_add_custom: register a custom KV connector class with KVConnectorFactory.register_connector by name, module path, and class name
get_connector_class_lookup: get a registered KV connector class by name using KVConnectorFactory.get_connector_class_by_name
get_connector_class_resolve: resolve the connector class from KVTransferConfig using KVConnectorFactory.get_connector_class
review_connector_hma_check: review whether a KV connector supports HMA via supports_hma before creating it with KVConnectorFactory.create_connector
